settings.heading: A gallery built around artists
settings.text: We started with one room, a handful of painters we believed in, and the idea that good art should be easy to live with. That idea still shapes everything we do.

settings.lead: Art is not a luxury object. It is a long conversation between the person who makes it and the person who lives with it.
settings.text: We work with artists over many years, not single shows. We visit studios, follow ideas as they grow, and give each body of work the time and space it needs. For collectors, we keep things simple and honest: clear prices, careful advice and no pressure.

settings.heading: A single white room
settings.text: The gallery opened in a small converted workshop with five artists and borrowed lights. The first show sold out in a week, mostly to neighbours who had never bought art before.

settings.heading: Time with the artists
settings.text: Most of our year is spent away from the gallery: in studios, at foundries, in weaving centres and print workshops. Knowing how a work is made helps us explain it, and helps collectors trust it.

settings.heading: On the wall and online
settings.text: We now show work in the gallery and in online viewing rooms, and send it, insured and packed by hand, to collectors around the world.
